title: Operating Agreement of Example Ventures LLC

articles.heading: Formation
articles.intro: The members hereby form a limited liability company under the laws of the state named below.

articles.heading: Purpose
body: The company may engage in any lawful business activity for which limited liability companies may be organized.
The company shall have all powers necessary or convenient to conduct such business.

articles.heading: Capital Contributions
body: Each member shall contribute the amounts set forth in Schedule A, which is incorporated by reference.

execution.statement: IN WITNESS WHEREOF, the undersigned has executed this Agreement as of the effective date above.
